summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest) + frontend (playwright) testing of BestBuyIncentives B2B sales-enablement marketing site. All 9 backend tests pass: health endpoint correctly reports email_enabled=false (placeholder Resend key), POST /api/leads creates lead with full + minimal payloads and persists (verified via GET /api/leads), invalid email returns 422, newsletter signup is idempotent (same id on duplicate email), ROI math matches expected values within 1% (annual=$602,820 expected, got ~$602,820). All frontend critical flows pass: home hero text 'Stop Discounting. Start Closing.' renders, sticky CTA appears after scroll past 800px, all 6 nav pages (/about, /programs, /industries, /case-studies, /resources, /contact) load with distinct content, resources detail page navigates correctly (uses slug, not 'incentive-hub-12'), contact form submission shows contact-success element with proper messaging, footer newsletter shows success toast, ROI calculator sliders trigger /api/roi/calculate (200 status) and updates roi-annual value live, Calendly inline iframe is rendered on /contact pointing to calendly.com/bestbuyincentives5/30min.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: review_request mentioned resource detail URL would be '/resources/incentive-hub-12' but actual implementation correctly uses slug-based routing (e.g., /resources/stop-discounting-start-closing). The review_request appears to have used REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL subdomain as a slug example by accident; implementation is correct.

Test data created in production DB (leads + newsletter). Consider TEST_ prefix scrub job. Currently TEST_ prefix is used in full_name and company but emails persisted include test_jane@example.com / test_minimal@example.com / test_newsletter_dedupe@example.com / test_ui_contact@example.com.
server.py imports `resend` at module load even though the key is a placeholder; harmless but consider deferred import inside _send_email when key is missing.
/api/leads returns 200 (default) — review_request expected 200, which matches. FastAPI convention would typically use 201 for created resources, but spec says 200 so this is acceptable.
test_credentials: None required - public marketing site, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Test leads (TEST Jane Doe, TEST Minimal, TEST UI Person) and newsletter signups (test_newsletter_dedupe@example.com, random test_nl_*@example.com) created in MongoDB during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - covers health, leads (CRUD + persistence via GET), newsletter idempotency, ROI math precision. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All endpoints under /api prefix. RESEND_API_KEY is PLACEHOLDER_KEY_REPLACE_LATER intentionally, email sending gracefully skips. Frontend testids confirmed: contact-name (not contact-full-name), contact-email, contact-company, contact-submit, contact-success, newsletter-email, newsletter-submit, roi-reps/roi-avg-deal/roi-deals-per-rep/roi-close-rate (Radix sliders - use role=slider thumb + keyboard arrows), roi-annual, sticky-cta (appears at scrollY>800), hero-cta-primary. Calendly inline widget renders an iframe with src starting with https://calendly.com/bestbuyincentives5/30min on /contact.
